symptom: `mxcli init` titled the generated CLAUDE.md `# Mendix Project: <repo folder>` (and named the devcontainer after it): a cloud session clones into a folder named after the repository, so a seed repo produced `Mendix Project: seed` for an app called ChipCoV8 (ChipCoV8/V9 bootstrap findings)
cause: `projectName := filepath.Base(absDir)` in init, add-tool and the `init --sync-skills` doc refresh — the folder stood in for the app name although the .mpr file name was already in hand
insight: Every consumer of projectName is a display name (doc headings, devcontainer `name`, comments) — paths use absDir/mprFile — so one helper covers them all. The sync path matters as much as init: fixing init alone would have the session hook's `init --sync-skills` retitle the doc after the folder again. The `project.mpr` placeholder (no .mpr found) keeps the folder name. Control: with the call sites reverted to filepath.Base the init and sync tests fail
